start.title: Welcome to Gwani
start.intro: Trusted local services and shops in Niger State. Create an account or log in to continue.
start.note: Customers sign up with an email; providers with their phone number and email.

login.title: Log in or sign up
login.intro: Customers log in with their email; providers with their phone number or email.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
login.rememberPhoneNote: Phone sign-in keeps you signed in here for {{days}} days. Untick this on a shared or borrowed phone.
login.rememberOnNote: You’ll stay signed in here for {{days}} days.
login.rememberOffNote: You’ll be signed out when you close the browser.
login.rememberStaffNote: Gwani staff are always signed out after {{hours}} hours.
login.codeIntro: For riders and Gwani staff, or if you’d rather get a code by SMS.
login.noAccount: There’s no account for this number yet.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: Nigerian mobile: 070, 080, 081, 090 or 091. You can start with 0 or +234.

otp.smsNote: We’ll text you a {{length}}-digit code. Standard SMS rates may apply.
otp.expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
otp.resendIn: Didn’t get it? You can resend in {{seconds}} s.
otp.resendInLong: You can ask for another code in {{time}}.

password.label: Password
password.rules: At least {{min}} characters; longer, with a mix of letters, numbers and symbols, is stronger.

dev.demoHint: Pick an account to fill in the form. Customer and vendors use the demo password; the rider and staff get the test code. All details are fake.

session.title: Session timing (dev)
session.applies: New lifetimes apply from the next sign-in (access tokens: from the next refresh).
session.refreshed: Refreshed: new access token, refresh token rotated.
session.reject: Make the server reject the access token
session.rejected: The next request will get a 401, refresh once, and retry.

signup.expiredBody: Enter your number again to get a new code.
signup.inviteExists: Your trade association already created your profile.

customer.title: Create your customer account
customer.intro: Book trusted local services and order from shops near you.
customer.emailHint: You’ll use it to log in. We’ll send a code to check it’s yours.
customer.phoneLater: No phone number needed now. Add one later in your profile for SMS reminders and cash or delivery orders.

provider.title: Create your provider account
provider.intro: Offer your services or sell your products to customers near you.
provider.locationHint: Customers nearby find you from this. It’s also your first service area; you can add more later.

rider.title: Sign up as a rider
rider.intro: Riders sign in with their phone number. We’ll text you a code.

setup.kindLegend: What kind of vendor are you?

check.name: Enter your name.
check.town: Enter your town or a landmark.
check.terms: Accept the provider terms to continue.

tip.searchText: Find plumbers, tailors, groceries and more in your LGA.
tip.badgesText: ID- and Trade-Verified vendors have been checked by Gwani.
tip.payText: Online payments are held until the work is done.

passwordReset.title: Reset your password

heading.identify: Where should we send a code?

passwordReset.intro: Enter the phone number or email on your account. If it has a password, we’ll send a code to reset it.
passwordReset.emailNote: We’ll email you a {{length}}-digit code. Check your spam folder if it doesn’t arrive.
passwordReset.sentTo: If an account exists for {{target}}, we’ve sent a code. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
passwordReset.passwordIntro: Use at least the minimum length; a longer mix of letters, numbers and symbols is stronger. You have {{minutes}} minutes to finish.
passwordReset.done: Your password was changed, and you’ve been signed out on every device. Log in with your new password.
passwordReset.doneSignedIn: Your password was changed. You’ve been signed out on your other devices and signed in here.

addRole.heading: Add a role
addRole.keepNote: You’ll keep everything you have now and can switch roles from the menu.
addRole.allBody: Switch between them from the menu.

guard.addRoleBody: Add the {{role}} role to your account to use it.
guard.staffOnly: Only Gwani staff can open this.

security.title: Email and password
security.intro: You sign in with your phone number. Add an email to get receipts.
security.introCustomer: You sign in with your phone number. Add an email to get receipts and, if you like, sign in with it and a password.
security.phoneOnlyNote: Email sign-in is for customer-only accounts. Because you also use Gwani as a provider, rider or staff member, keep signing in with your phone.

toast.passwordSet: Password set. You can now sign in with your email.

terms.title: Provider terms
terms.subtitle: Placeholder: the final terms will be published here
terms.placeholder: These are placeholder terms for the demo.
terms.item1: The details on your profile are yours and are correct.
terms.item2: You quote honestly, turn up when booked, and keep customers’ details private.
terms.item3: Online payments are held in escrow and released when the work is done, minus Gwani’s commission.
terms.item4: Your subscription renews monthly; your profile is restricted if it lapses.

rider.subtitle: Rider dashboard
rider.comingSoonText: Soon you’ll see orders to deliver in your area here. We’ll let you know when it’s ready.

claim.title: Claim your Gwani profile
claim.alreadyBody: This profile has been claimed. Sign in with your phone number to manage it.
claim.cancelledBody: Contact your association if you think this is a mistake.
claim.expiredBody: Ask your association or Gwani to send a new one.
claim.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {{phone}}, but you’re signed in as {{name}}.
claim.intro: {{association}} added {{business}} to Gwani. Customers can’t see it until you claim it. This link works until {{date}}.
claim.name: Name
claim.termsLine: I accept the <termsLink>provider terms</termsLink>, and my association pays for my plan under its bundle.
claim.yearsInvalid: Years of experience should be a whole number.
claim.acceptTerms: Accept the provider terms to continue.

error.invalid: This link isn’t valid. Check you copied all of it, or ask your association to resend it.
error.claimed: This profile has already been claimed. Sign in with your phone number instead.
error.revoked: This invitation was cancelled. Contact your association.
error.expired: This link has expired. Ask your association or Gwani to resend it.
error.terms: Accept the provider terms to continue.

error.resendTooSoon_one: Wait {{count}} second before asking for another code.
error.resendTooSoon_other: Wait {{count}} seconds before asking for another code.

error.lockedNow: Too many wrong codes. For your security this number is locked for {{time}}.
error.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.wrongCode_one: That code isn’t right. {{count}} try left.
error.wrongCode_other: That code isn’t right. {{count}} tries left.
error.signupExpired: Your verification has expired. Enter your number again to get a new code.
error.invalidCredentials: That email and password don’t match an account. Check them and try again, or sign in with your phone number.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{time}}, or sign in with your phone number.
error.emailLooksWrong: That email address doesn’t look right.
error.emailTakenSignup: Use a different email address, or leave it blank.
error.accountExists: This number already has an account. Sign in instead.
error.setUpRider: Set up your rider details first.
error.emailCustomersOnly: Email sign-in is for customer accounts. Keep signing in with your phone number.
error.verifyEmailFirst: Add and verify an email first.
error.roleMissing: You don’t have that role yet. Add it from your profile.
error.haveVendor: You already have a vendor profile.
error.phoneHasVendor: This phone number already has a vendor profile. Sign in with it, or contact Gwani support if that isn’t you.
error.inviteExists: {{association}} has already created a profile for this number. Claim it instead of starting a new one.
error.tradeKindMismatch: {{trade}} is a {{kind}} trade. Pick a matching trade.
error.enterTown: Enter your town or a landmark.
error.acceptTerms: Accept the provider terms to continue.
error.checkPlate: Check the plate number (letters and numbers, e.g. BSS 123 NG).
error.invitePhoneMismatch: This invitation is for a different phone number.
error.staffSignIn: You need to be signed in as Gwani staff.
error.needProvider: This needs a provider account with a vendor profile.
error.accountSuspended: This staff account is suspended. Ask a Super admin to reactivate it.
error.resendLimit: You’ve asked for the most codes allowed for now. Try again in {{time}}.
error.resetLocked: Too many wrong codes. For your security, password reset is locked for {{time}} more.
error.resetLockedNow: Too many wrong codes. For your security, password reset is locked for {{time}}.
error.deviceLimited: Too many reset requests from this device. Try again in {{time}}.
error.samePassword: Choose a password you haven’t used for this account just now. It can’t be the same as your current one.
error.resetExpired: Your reset session has expired or was already used. Start again to get a new code.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.emailInUse: This email can’t be used for a new account.
error.phoneInUse: This phone number can’t be used for a new account.
error.verifyToBook: Verify your email (or phone number) first. It only takes a minute.
error.useSignupForm: Create your account from the signup page.
error.emailLocked: Too many wrong codes. For your security, email verification is locked for {{time}} more.
error.emailLockedNow: Too many wrong codes. For your security, email verification is locked for {{time}}.

ended.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to carry on where you were.
ended.idle: You were signed out because you weren’t active for a while. Sign in again to carry on.
ended.elsewhere: You were signed out in another tab or window.

session.idleTitle_one: You’ll be signed out in {{count}} second
session.idleTitle_other: You’ll be signed out in {{count}} seconds
session.idleText: You haven’t been active for a while. Stay signed in?

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.intro: These devices are signed in to your Gwani account. If you don’t recognise one, sign it out and change your password.
sessions.signOutAll: Log out of all other devices
sessions.confirmTitle: Log out of all other devices?
sessions.confirmText_one: {{count}} other device will be signed out straight away. This device stays signed in.
sessions.confirmText_other: {{count}} other devices will be signed out straight away. This device stays signed in.
sessions.securityNote: Changing or resetting your password also signs out every other device.
sessions.notFound: That device is already signed out.

form.nameMin: Enter your full name (at least 2 characters).
form.identifierRequired: Enter your email or phone number.
form.identifierInvalid: Enter a valid email or a Nigerian phone number.

email.title: Check your email
email.intro: Enter the 6-digit code we sent, so we know the email is yours.
email.laterNote: You can look around now. You’ll need a verified email to book or pay.

phone.title: Verify your phone number
phone.introProvider: Enter the code we text you. Customers can only see your business once your phone is verified.
phone.introCustomer: We’ll use it for SMS reminders and for cash or delivery orders.
phone.laterNote: You can set up your business first. It stays hidden from customers until your phone is verified.

phoneProvider.title: Customers can’t see your business yet
phoneProvider.text: Verify your phone number to appear in search and receive requests.

emailCustomer.title: Verify your email to book and pay
emailCustomer.text: You can look around now. Enter the code we emailed you before you book or pay.

emailLater.title: Verify your email
emailLater.text: Confirm your email when you have a moment, for receipts and account alerts.

vendorSetup.location: Base location: {{town}}, {{lga}} LGA. You can change it later in your profile.
